description: This file defines the JPAEspetaculoDao class, which implements the Agenda interface for database operations related to Espetaculo and Sessao entities using JPA EntityManager.

classes.name: JPAEspetaculoDao
classes.description: Implements the Agenda interface to manage Espetaculo and Sessao entities with JPA. Provides methods for listing, creating, and retrieving shows and sessions, as well as scheduling sessions.

methods.name: JPAEspetaculoDao
methods.description: Constructor injection of EntityManager and Relogio.

methods.name: espetaculos
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Espetaculo entities from the database.

methods.name: cadastra
methods.description: Persists a new Espetaculo entity to the database.

methods.name: proximasSessoes
methods.description: Fetches upcoming Sessao entities scheduled after the current date, limited to a maximum number.

methods.name: sessao
methods.description: Finds and returns a Sessao by its ID.

methods.name: espetaculo
methods.description: Finds and returns an Espetaculo by its ID.

methods.name: agende
methods.description: Schedules a list of Sessao entities by persisting them.
